# infisical_email_domain_verification (Resource)

Verify an email domain that was claimed with `infisical_email_domain`. Infisical looks up the DNS TXT record named in `verification_record_name` and expects the value in `verification_code`. Create retries while the record is not found yet, because DNS changes take time to propagate, and waits up to the create value in timeouts (default: 10m). If the domain is no longer verified, the next plan creates this resource again. The API cannot remove a verification, so destroying this resource only removes it from the Terraform state. Verifying a domain needs a plan that includes SAML, LDAP or OIDC SSO. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_email_domain" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

# Publish a DNS TXT record before the verification runs, with your DNS provider's resource:
#   name:  infisical_email_domain.example.verification_record_name
#   value: infisical_email_domain.example.verification_code
# Add that resource to depends_on below, so Terraform creates the record first.

resource "infisical_email_domain_verification" "example" {
  email_domain_id = infisical_email_domain.example.id

  # Verification retries while the DNS record propagates.
  timeouts = {
    create = "15m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email_domain_id` (String) The ID of the email domain to verify (the `id` of an `infisical_email_domain`).

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the verified email domain. The same value as `email_domain_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) How long Terraform retries the verification while the DNS TXT record is not found, such as "5m" or "30m". Defaults to 10m.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the verification by the ID of the verified email domain
terraform import infisical_email_domain_verification.example <email_domain_id>
```
